description: Use this when the user wants a tip out calculator: servers or bartenders tip out a percent of their sales or tips to support staff (bussers, bartenders, hosts, food runners, barbacks). Takes each server's sales and/or tips and the tip-out rules (e.g. busser 3% of sales, bar 1.5% of sales), plus optional support staff with roles and hours. Returns each server's tip-out per role (rounded to the cent), what each server keeps, each support person's share by hours with largest-remainder rounding so it adds up to what was tipped out, warnings, and a printable PDF tip-out sheet with signature lines plus a CSV. Does not give legal advice, compute wages or taxes, or connect to a POS. Do not use for a shared pool split by hours (use calculate_tip_pool) or for a bill split among diners.

currency.description: ISO currency code, default USD, e.g. EUR.

label.description: Optional title for the tip-out sheet, e.g. "Saturday dinner".

points.description: Tip points for the points method, e.g. 2 or 1.5.

shift.description: Shift or day this row belongs to, for a week view, e.g. "Mon" or "Fri dinner".

servers.description: Servers or bartenders who tip out, each with sales and/or tips. Array of {name, sales, tips}, or pasted lines, e.g. [{"name":"Ana","sales":1850,"tips":340}] or "Ana sales 1850 tips 340\nBen sales 1420 tips 260".

points.description: Tip points for the points method, e.g. 2 or 1.5.

shift.description: Shift or day this row belongs to, for a week view, e.g. "Mon" or "Fri dinner".

support_staff.description: Optional people receiving the tip-out, with role and hours, e.g. [{"name":"Kim","role":"busser","hours":6}]. Each role's tip-out is split among its people by hours (equal if no hours).

tip_out_basis.description: "sales" or "tips": what a percent without "of sales" or "of tips" is taken from. Default: sales when every server has sales, else tips.

tip_outs.description: Who gets what share, e.g. "busser 3% of sales, bartender 1.5% of sales, host 1% of sales" or [{"role":"busser","percent":3,"basis":"sales"}]. A plain 3 or "3%" means 3% to the support staff as one group.

name: calculate_tip_out
